text:
luis: Heads up — canary of the driver+NCCL bump (driver 555.23 + NCCL 3.3.1) on the H100 inference pool in h1-us-west3 shows frequent P2P handshake stalls, causing long-tail latency for multi-GPU inference. Repro rate ~7/20 canaries. :grimacing:

maya: ugh. any logs? which kernel/OS?

luis: pasted logs from one host:
```
[1234.567890] nccl: ncclNet_llHandshake: timeout waiting for P2P ack from peer 10.0.8.12: ret=-110
[1234.568901] nv_peer_mem: failed to register memory region -22
[1234.569012] pci 0000:06:00.0: p2p: peer path setup failed, err=-110
stack: ncclNet_connect -> ncclNet_getTransportAttr -> ncclCommInitRank -> ...
```

sam: does it happen on A100 too?

luis: Not on A100. Only on H100 nodes with NVLINK3 topology. Also seeing intermittent pci-e p2p errors in dmesg. Looks like a driver/firmware+NCCL interaction.

jon: can you run `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` on a repro node and paste outputs?

luis: quick outputs:
```
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
        GPU0    GPU1    GPU2    GPU3
GPU0     X      NV1     PHB     PHB
GPU1    NV1      X      PHB     PHB
... (NVLINK present)

$ cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module 555.23  Mon Oct 10 12:34:56 PDT 2025
CUDA Version: 12.2
Container NCCL: 3.3.1
```

anita: @ops-oncall can we isolate traffic? drain that canary pool or divert? :eyes: 

ops-oncall: On it. Temporarily draining new inference canaries from h1-us-west3. Existing jobs allowed to finish; not killing. Routing new traffic to h1-us-west2 (A100) and eu-central1 pools.

infra-bot: Rollout task 78921 paused (auto). Canary acceptance p99 latency > 2x baseline. Current p99 = 3.5x. See https://console.redwood/rollouts/78921

maya: lets try swapping NCCL only — build a canary with NCCL 3.2.x (keep driver same) to confirm whether NCCL 3.3.1 is the issue.

luis: I built nccl-3.2.1 image and pushed tag `canary/nccl-3.2.1-driver555`. Kicking 3-node canary now (h1-us-west3 test subset).

sam: also grab a runtime stack when it hangs: `curl -s http://localhost:13000/trace | jq .` and post.

luis: trace shows workers stuck: `AllReduce timeout at step=2345`, all ranks blocked waiting at `ncclCommInitRank`. No sign of user-code deadlock.

anita: good that this seems isolated to H100. If downgrade fixes it we should pin NCCL until we get a vendor fix. What is cost/impact to capacity?

jon: draining h1-us-west3 H100 pool reduces H100 capacity ~12%. Routing to A100 increases per-token cost ~18% but keeps latency SLOs intact for user traffic.

ops-oncall: INC-2026 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026 — P2 priority. Assigning eng-runtime + eng-infra.

luis: quick update — nccl-3.2.1 canary running on 3 test nodes for 30m: zero handshake timeouts so far, p99 latency back to baseline.

maya: ok plan: 1) Roll back NCCL to 3.2.x for H100 pools (global pin) 2) Continue root-cause triage with driver + firmware vendors for NCCL 3.3.1 3) Add expanded canary matrix (drivers/firmware/NCCL combos).

sam: vendor note: they suggested checking `nv_peer_mem` + iommu config. They mentioned `NVreg_EnablePeerAccess=1` might affect p2p behavior. Need to be cautious before flipping kernel module params in prod.

anita: assign follow-up tickets to eng-ml (investigation) and eng-infra (fleet validation). cc @platform-qa for expanded canary coverage.

ops-oncall: starting rollout override — pin nccl=3.2.1 for H100 pools. ETA ~45m to update all nodes; updating in 10% batches. Posting progress.

infra-bot: Rollout task 78921 resumed with override -> pinned nccl 3.2.1 for H100.

luis: I'll collect full dmesg, kernel trace, and upload tarball to the incident doc. Tagging owners: luis, maya, sam, jon.

maya: please also add a perf checkpoint in Redwood Optimize so future canaries fail fast on this regression class.

ops-oncall: update: 25% nodes updated, no regressions seen on the rolled nodes. Continuing.

anita: note for postmortem: compare H100 firmware diffs across regions and add explicit compatibility matrix for driver+NCCL+firmware in the onboarding runbook.

luis: thanks everyone — filing the follow-ups in INC-2026 and ENG-TASKs. Will keep thread updated as rollback completes. :thumbsup:
